question: Devendra Jhajharia won which medal/place in World Para Athletics Grand Prix?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Silver**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Devendra Jhajharia** won the **Silver medal** in the **World Para Athletics Grand Prix 2022**.
 
• He is a renowned** Indian Paralympic javelin thrower** and has achieved numerous accolades in his career.
 
• Jhajharia is the first Indian Paralympian to win two gold medals </st
